shared_elements: shallow relief curvilinear carving on stone surface
pair of large opposed curved forms
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, rounded-groove relief built from large curved crescent forms combined with a circular/ring element, which is the most specific correspondence, and both read as schematic rather than naturalistic. However, B is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic statue with a clearly rendered face, ears, arms and a stacked sequence of body-mounted motifs (ring, crescents, banded lines), while A is a flat rock panel with one dominant ambiguous curved figure and no comparable face or ordered vertical scheme, so the relationships and arrangement do not match.
